# Tool reference

16 tools from the keyless `tools/list` response of `https://app.singitai.app/mcp`
(server `singit` "SingIt x402" 0.1.3, protocol 2025-06-18).
Snapshot taken 31 October 2026; `npm run check:live` compares it with the live server.

Paid tools are charged per call to the API key's own SingIt limits, and repeating a call charges again.
`get_limits` shows what the key has spent and what is left today.

| Tool | What it does | Parameters | Needs a key? | Key scope | Network |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `get_price` | Current price of a major cryptocurrency, gold or silver (Chainlink on Base), or an exchange rate between two currencies. | `kind` (required), `symbol`, `base`, `quote` | No | none | No payment |
| `list_price_symbols` | Every crypto, metal and currency symbol get_price supports. | none | No | none | No payment |
| `list_models` | The AI models (chat, images or audio) available through SingIt, with their prices. | `kind` | No | none | No payment |
| `get_balance` | Your SingIt API balance: available and held USDC, auto top-up and pending top-ups. | none | Yes (free, read-only) | account read, no paid-tool scope | Account data |
| `get_limits` | What your API key may still spend: its daily and per-request caps, spent and remaining today, scopes and expiry, plus your account's balance and, on Base, your allowance limiter (caps, left today, approved from your wallet, paused = emergency stop, expired). | none | Yes (free, read-only) | account read, no paid-tool scope | Account data |
| `get_receipts` | Your recent receipts, newest first: for each, its id, time, model, USDC charged, tokens and the upstream reference (kind charge, this key only), or the account's top-ups and refunds with their transaction and network. | `limit`, `kind`, `before` | Yes (free, read-only) | account read, no paid-tool scope | Account data |
| `web_search` | Searches the web through Exa and returns titles, URLs and snippets of matching pages. | `query` (required), `numResults`, `type` | Yes (paid) | search | USDC on Base or Solana |
| `read_page` | The readable text of one web page (up to 8000 characters), through Exa. | `url` (required) | Yes (paid) | search | USDC on Base or Solana |
| `get_weather` | A sample weather forecast from GoPlausible's x402 demo service on Algorand. | none | Yes (paid) | tools | USDC, Base accounts only for now |
| `get_singit_risk_check` | SingIt's risk check on Bankr x402 Cloud, run on a fixed sample payment request (no input). | none | Yes (paid) | tools | USDC, Base accounts only for now |
| `get_x_profile` | Public profile data for an X (Twitter) account by username, from twit.sh's x402 API. | `username` (required) | Yes (paid) | tools | USDC, Base accounts only for now |
| `get_crypto_news` | Latest crypto market headlines with sentiment, from Otto AI. | none | Yes (paid) | tools | USDC, Base accounts only for now |
| `get_hyperliquid_market` | One Hyperliquid perpetual market (e.g. | `asset` (required) | Yes (paid) | tools | USDC, Base accounts only for now |
| `get_funding_rates` | Funding rates for one symbol across exchanges, with open interest, long/short ratio, large positions and liquidations, from Otto AI. | `symbol` (required) | Yes (paid) | tools | USDC, Base accounts only for now |
| `resolve_ens` | Turns an ENS name (e.g. | `input` (required), `network` | Yes (paid) | tools | USDC, Base accounts only for now |
| `get_token_price` | USD price of a major token by symbol from a paid x402 price API. | `symbol` (required) | Yes (paid) | tools | USDC, Base accounts only for now |
